lead.default: Work doesn’t need another place to become busy. It needs a place to become clear.

bodyOne.default: NextSaas explores a simple idea: bring the plan, the reasoning, and the people closer together. Not to measure every moment, but to make the next move easier to understand.

bodyTwo.default: That means less hunting for context. Fewer disconnected handoffs. And more room for the part of work that asks something of us.
